messages:
harper: impromptu ramen + LAN tonight at the kitchenette 7pm? short sessions, bring pocket consoles.
drew: on my way — bringing instant ramen + a kettle. anyone want spicy miso or shoyu?
sam: spicy miso please. also i'll bring a spare ethernet cable in case the wifi craps out.
izzy: i'll bring the Switch and a USB-C adapter. can someone grab bowls and chopsticks?
snack-bot: reminder scheduled: "Bring bowls + disposable chopsticks" at 6:45 PM.
harper: cool. tiny rule: no slurping directly into controllers. :laughing: see you at 7.
drew: i'll also bring napkins. peace to the cables.
sam: mini-tourney suggestion: best 3 drift laps in Mario Kart for the last ramen bowl. stakes: bragging rights.
izzy: i'm in. bring your A-game (and sauce stains protection).
